text:
Type: natural jute flatwoven rug
Use: covering floors, defining a seating area; living room, bedroom, hallway, dining room
Style: coastal, bohemian, rustic
Materials: hand-woven natural jute, chunky flatweave texture
Colors: warm natural tan, light brown, beige
Shape: rectangular, thick coarse weave in fine vertical ribs, plain edges, flat and low, textured surface, large and grounding
Feel: earthy, warm, relaxed, natural
Goes with: white or linen sofas, light wood, rattan and plants; coastal, bohemian, Japandi or farmhouse living rooms

product.name: LOHALS
product.description: Jute is a durable and recyclable material with natural colour variations.
